description: Land Acquisition - Maliduwa, Hikkaduwa D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land (described in detail with lot numbers, boundaries, and measurements) are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content focuses exclusively on land matters - property descriptions, boundaries, and acquisition procedures - which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the land-focused content and does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government classification type.
